governance.canonical_statuses: schema lifecycle (idea→draft→review→approved-with-amendments→approved→implemented + cancelled/blocked/deprecated/superseded/archived), SoT .knowledge/schema.yaml; canonical_status enum draft/candidate/approved/deprecated; Active Canon = source_kind canonical + status in {approved, approved-with-amendments, implemented, delivered}; one Active Canon per node (DMR §12 Variant C, CFT-001)
governance.candidate_statuses: canonical_status: candidate; process: CANDIDATE FOR CANON REVIEW (PDP §6.2), READY_FOR_OWNER_REVIEW (CANON_INDEX), CANDIDATE FOR PRODUCT OWNER REVIEW (both governance standards, outside PDP §6.2 vocabulary — mismatch)
governance.historical_handoff_statuses: SUPERSEDED / LEGACY / SUPERSEDED_PENDING_REAPPROVAL (CANON_INDEX; last one used but not declared); deprecated/archived (DMR); handoff per Glossary §17
governance.acceptance_rules: window path: authoring → review → READY_FOR_OWNER_REVIEW → owner approval → CANONICAL by orchestrator; PDP 10 phases with TRACEABILITY CLEAN + ARCHITECTURE READY FOR WRITER + Canon Review READY FOR CANON; 'Ayla's normal approval rules' (PDP §3.10) not defined as a single block — GAP
governance.owner_rules: Product Owner sole approver of Product decisions (PDP §4); Constitution changes require founder approval + domain sign-offs; CANONICAL only after owner approval
governance.dependency_rules: implements/depends_on/adr/related/conflicts_with/supersedes; directed, acyclic, target must exist (KAS §7, DMR §7); conflicts_with requires resolution note
governance.superseding_rules: supersedes only between distinct logical documents; previous revision lives in Git history, not a Knowledge Node (KAS §3.1-3.2); newer date gives no priority
governance.decision_rules: AYLA-DEC-XXXX; Decision Log holds 0001…0026+0035; OWNER_DECISION_REGISTER holds 0026…0079; boundary is a historical note, not a normative rule; OD only after 6-step P0 ladder (CANON_CONFLICT_REGISTER)
governance.adr_rules: type adr with adr_id/decision_status/revision/amendments/superseded_by (DMR §6); changes via owner decision or ADR + impact analysis + migration plan
governance.validation_entrypoint: python scripts/validate_knowledge.py (local + GitHub Actions); renderer python scripts/render_domain_registry.py --check
governance.source_of_truth_hierarchy: Constitution → Product Essence → LDT Manifesto / Vision / Thesis / Principles → MVP Scope → User Journey → Domain Models → UX → Engineering → Implementation; knowledge-SoT: schema.yaml → DMR → Glossary; Knowledge Area Taxonomy: 00 Foundation, 01 Product, 05 Architecture, 06 Product, 07 UX, 08 Engineering, 09 Operations
